task.title: Make elements transparent
task.shortdesc: The opacity property makes an element and everything inside it transparent, as one group.

step.cmd: Set the opacity of an element

info.p: The value of opacity is a number from 0 to 1, or a percentage. The value 1, or 100%, is the initial one and draws the element as it is. The value 0 draws nothing. A value above 1 counts as 1 and a value below 0 counts as 0. A value that is not a number or a percentage is ignored and the element keeps the initial opacity.
You write the value in a rule of a style sheet:

Opacity works on shapes, text, images, groups, use elements and nested svg elements. The property is not inherited, but the opacities of nested elements multiply: a shape with opacity: 0.5 inside a group with opacity: 0.5 is drawn at one quarter of its color.

It also works on the boxes of your document. A box with an opacity below 1 is drawn with its background, its border, its text and the boxes inside it as one picture, and then the picture is made transparent. The box and everything in it fade together, and the boxes inside do not show through each other.

step.cmd: Fade a group as one picture

info.p: CSSMedia draws an element with an opacity below 1 as one picture, and then makes the picture transparent. When you set the opacity on a group, the shapes inside it do not show through each other where they overlap. When you set the same opacity on each shape, they do.

The properties fill-opacity and stroke-opacity are different. They make only the fill or only the outline of one shape transparent, and they do not group anything. Use them when you want the fill of a shape to be transparent and its outline to stay solid. The SVG chapter explains them.

stepxmp.pre: <g class="faded"> <rect x="10" y="10" width="60" height="40" fill="#6fc3e8"/> <rect x="40" y="30" width="60" height="40" fill="#f2d649"/> </g>

info.p: An element with an opacity below 1 is also an isolated group for blending. The blend modes of the elements inside it mix with each other and not with what is behind the group.
